text: Said it was open but nobody there, we rang the bell so many times and no one came at all. The Bophut clinic across the road however helped straight away!

Before I even got to receive service, I was spoken to rudely by the staff. I called and didn't know if they were busy or available. The way they spoke was so rude, it was like they were going to bite my neck. I didn't dare go in at all.
author_name: เยาวดี นวลปาน

text: I just called to inquire about the price, and the way they spoke was like they were going to eat my head.
The check-up went well. The doctor asked about symptoms, performed the examination, and offered options to the patient. The staff were also friendly and provided good service. 👍🏻 …
